title: Security Scanning Exception Configuration
description: Documented false positives and reviewed security exceptions for secret and dependency scanning.

secretExceptions.reason: Simulated secret patterns used strictly in unit tests for negative security scanner testing.

dependencyExceptions.reason: Transitive sub-dependency of postcss; custom generator size=0 edge case is unused in application/build code paths.
Transitive dev-dependency of ESLint config (@eslint/eslintrc); maxTotalMergeKeys CPU consumption on empty merge sources does not affect runtime applications as no untrusted YAML is parsed.

Platform-specific RCE restricted to Windows-hosted servers; staging and production runtime environments strictly run on containerized Linux (node:20-alpine / Railway PaaS), rendering Windows path traversal unexploitable.

Next.js Image Optimization API RCE triggered by AVIF files; application does not configure AVIF image formats, uses zero external image uploads, and relies strictly on static SVGs and remote avatars from approved Google/Pinterest origins.
Vulnerabilities in libheif decoder bundled in sharp sub-dependency; application processes only numerical IoT telemetry and does not ingest or decode HEIF/HEIC image assets.
